description: Read school campuses, optionally limited to a course belonging to this school. Default status=open requires explicitly open school campuses and course relationships. status=all preserves closed/unknown. Filter by state, four-digit postcode or Category 2/Category 3. Unknown region is not non-regional. Default pageSize 10, maximum 20; continuation requires contentVersion. Counts and campusStates refer to the full filtered collection. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

name: get_school_campuses
title: Read school campuses
